This is how easy it is to get to us

Close to the Baltic Sea coast, between Wismar and Rostock

Coming on the A20 from Lübeck, Rostock or Berlin, drive to the Wismar junction and follow the signs to “Insel Poel”.
In Groß-Strömkendorf the road splits into two directions at the hotel Schäfereck. Turn right and you will see the church spire of Dreveskirchen. Follow the main road signs until you have passed the church. Please pay attention to the speed limit of 30 km/h. The nearest town is Stove. At the crossroads turn left and after 100 m follow the sign Haus Hoppe – Galerie für Bildende Kunst.

buy-fine-art.title: Buy Fine Art - HAUS HOPPE
buy-fine-art.article:
Acquire art

I welcome you to visit my gallery at the Baltic Sea. Here you can discover many of my works on an exhibition area of about 400 m². Purchase numerous paintings and multi-colored woodcuts directly on site. You can already get an overview online with the help of the works page.

During your visit, take advantage of the opportunity to participate in a personal guided tour of HAUS HOPPE – Galerie für Bildende Kunst, where you will be introduced to the artist’s oeuvre and have your questions about craft, composition, art and art history answered.

Innovative ways to art

Art installment

For the private sector I offer you the possibility to pay the art purchase in monthly installments.

e.g. with a total value of 500,– € / payment 10 x a 50,– €

Art Leasing

Leasing instalments are immediately tax-deductible as business expenses. This is, among other things, an advantage with regard to trade tax. Once the agreed residual value has been determined, you decide on the further “use” of the work of art.
With HW Leasing GmbH, I have had a reliable partner for years who can realize your ideas quickly and flexibly.

If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.

HW Leasing GmbH
Spiegelberg 57
23966 Wismar
Phone: +49 3841 711111
Fax: +49 3841 711148
[email protected]

ART ON ORDER

Many of my art friends have been with me for years. Of course, in the first half of your life you mainly take care of your family, children and job. That leaves little room for the acquisition of a valuable work of art. However, many have the hope of being able to make up for the purchase later. But later is often too late – because my works of art usually find a new home quickly.

Therefore it is a special pleasure for me to be able to fulfil the wish of my friends nevertheless. I create a second original of the favorite motif as an art commission. Gladly also for you!

See for yourself:

Individual wishes

Would you like to have your grandchild portrayed, design a facade or commission a work of art for a very special occasion? Just contact me!

The following three examples represent a range of individual works:

– “View of Schwaan Castle” for a retirement home
– House altar homage to Hieronymus Bosch
– Design of a swimming pool
